chapter_name: Feeding and Care of Farm Animals
learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to properly feed, house, and care for farm animals to keep them healthy, happy, and productive!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Taking care of farm animals like cows, goats, and chickens is a huge responsibility. Good care involves providing the right food, clean drinking water, and a safe place to sleep.
Just like humans need balanced meals, animals need a mix of green fodder, dry hay, and nutrient-rich grains. This balanced diet helps them grow strong and fight off diseases.
Farm animals need protection from extreme heat, rain, and cold. A good animal shelter must have proper roofs, comfortable bedding, and plenty of fresh air flowing through.
Keeping the animal pens clean is the best way to stop germs from spreading. Regular bathing, vaccinations, and daily cleaning of their living area keeps the whole farm healthy!

fun_activity.title: 🐄 Farm Diet Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Visit a local dairy or watch a virtual farm tour online! Make a list of three different types of food the farmers give their animals and write down why each is important.

quick_recap: ⭐ Proper livestock care requires a balance of nutritious food, clean water, and safe shelter.
⭐ A mix of green fodder and grains provides the energy animals need to stay productive.
⭐ Daily hygiene and clean pens are essential for preventing diseases on the farm.
